thesis: Round-trip swap rounding extraction: Attacker executes many tiny A->B->A swaps, accumulating rounding errors that favor attacker over protocol
evidence: SwapMath rounds amountIn UP and amountOut DOWN in all paths. Forge test (test_dustSwapsNeverProfitable) confirmed 50 dust round-trips result in net loss. SqrtPriceMath getAmountDelta uses roundUp=true for inputs, roundUp=false for outputs.

thesis: Flash loan cross-token fee arbitrage: Borrow token A, pay fee in cheap token B, extract value from denomination mismatch
evidence: Flash loan separates loanToken and feeToken balance checks (AMMModule.sol:3310-3370). Each token tracked independently. feeToken must be validated by hook (L3421-3434). No denomination mismatch in fee storage or collection.

thesis: Queued hook fee double-collection via ERC777 reentrancy: During _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers, ERC777 callback allows hook to call collectHookFeesByHook and collect same fees twice
evidence: Queue zeroed at L3189 before processing. _transferHookFeesByHook decrements storage BEFORE transfer (L3129). Underflow check at L3130 prevents over-withdrawal. ENTERED bit preserved by _setReentrancyFlags, blocking nonReentrant functions.
